name: University College Cork
description: University College Cork is a public research university in Cork, founded in 1845 as Queen's College Cork. It has over 26,000 students.
whyIncluded: Its MB BCh BAO is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, and Ireland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 270 in UNESCO UIS data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: UCC International Office 'Cost of Living' monthly ranges (page updated 8 July 2026), taken at midpoints: housing = on-campus accommodation EUR 800-1,030 (option 1; private complexes EUR 800-2,222, house share EUR 700-900 excl. bills) plus utilities EUR 120; food EUR 120-240; travel (bus with Leap Card) EUR 26-30; personal = mobile phone EUR 20 plus personal expenses (social/sports) EUR 200-300. UCC's overall range is EUR 1,181-2,923 a month. Academic year runs September to May (9 months).

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Computer Science (CK401)
programmes.notes: UCC Fees Office international (non-EU) undergraduate schedule 2026/27, full-time fee per academic year; 4-year degree.
